sections.text_helper: Section 28.6 "XSPI interrupts" in chapter 28 (Extended-SPI interface (XSPI)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1327.
sections.section_content:
An interrupt can be produced on the following events:
• timeout
• status match
• FIFO threshold
• transfer complete
• transfer error
Separate interrupt enable bits are available to provide more flexibility.
[Table 200. XSPI interrupt requests]
